annotations.title: Document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV) to Markdown

description: Markdown of a document at a public URL, up to 10 MB: PDF (page count, title, created and modified dates from its metadata), DOCX, ODT, XLSX/XLS, ODS, Numbers (sheet names), CSV, XML or HTML; plain text is returned as served. Returns file name, MIME type, size, Markdown, word count, token estimate and truncation flag. Images are not converted. Conversion: Cloudflare Workers AI toMarkdown; fetch via validated redirects, DNS checks via Cloudflare DoH. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of Markdown returned, 1000 to 100000. Default 20000. Longer output is cut at a line boundary and flagged truncated.

url.description: http or https URL of a PDF, DOCX, ODT, XLSX, XLS, ODS, Numbers, CSV, XML or HTML file (at most 10 MB). Default ports only; credentials, IP addresses, localhost and private or single-label names are rejected.
